protocol.name: touch_only_surface
protocol.description:
This protocol allows a client to mark wl_surface objects as touch-only.
A touch-only surface participates in hit testing and receives input events as usual, but the compositor may choose not to composite it into the visible scene. In the Qualcomm SDM backend, a touch-only surface is used as an invisible proxy for virtual machine content: it receives touch events based on its input region, but is not drawn by the renderer.

request.name: set_touch_only

description.summary: set or clear touch-only state for a surface

request.description:
Mark the given wl_surface as touch-only when enabled != 0, or clear the touch-only state when enabled == 0.
When a surface is touch-only, it will still be used for input hit testing (according to its input region), but will not be composited by the renderer.
The behavior for surfaces without an attached buffer is compositor-specific; in the SDM backend this is typically used with proxy surfaces that have dummy buffers and viewport destination set to the VM area.

arg.name: surface
arg.summary: the surface to mark as touch-only

arg.name: enabled
arg.summary: non-zero to enable, zero to disable
